This document contains the code used for visualizing data merging and log transformation in preparation for BMD analysis as presented in 'Advancing AOPs for genotoxicity through quantifying KERs linking DNA alkylation to increase in mutations and chromosome aberrations' by Winkelman et al., 2026. The output generated by this code forms the basis for Figure S3 along with: Figures/BMD/bias_summaries/EMS_MN_LIFC_fixed1_bias_summary.png, Figures/BMD/fitgrids/EMS_MN_LIFC_fixed1_fitgrid.png and Figures/BMD/bootplots/EMS_MN_LIFC_fixed1_bootplot.png which were all generated from the 6_BMD_full_analysis.Rmd file.

Read in libraries
```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
source('Functions_BMD.R')
```

Read in data
```{r}
EMS_subsets = readRDS('../processedData/EMS_subsets.rds')
doseres_df = EMS_subsets$MN$data[[2]] #LIFC
merged = merge_study_data(doseres_df)
```



```{r}

# ============================================================
# Shared y-axis limits
# ============================================================

common_ylim = c(0, 20)

# ============================================================
# Study-level plot
# ============================================================

p_studies = plot_dose_response(
  df = doseres_df,
  conc_col = "Concentration EMS",
  res_col = "FC",
  sem_col = "FC_SEM",
  sd_col = 'FC_SD',
  rep_col = 'replicates',
  unit_col = "Concentration unit (eg μg/ml or μM)",
  color_col = "Study index",
  ylim = common_ylim,
  custom_colors = c(
    "#1b9e77",
    "#d95f02",
    "#7570b3"
  ),
  title = ""
)

# ============================================================
# Merged plot
# ============================================================

p_merged = plot_dose_response(
  df = merged,
  conc_col = "Concentration",
  res_col = "FC",
  sem_col = "SEM",
  sd_col = "SD",
  rep_col = "total_replicates",
  unit_col = "Concentration_unit",
  ylim = common_ylim,
  title = ""
)

# ============================================================
# Merged plot logtransform
# ============================================================

plog_merged = plot_dose_response(
  df = merged,
  conc_col = "Concentration",
  res_col = "FC",
  sem_col = "SEM",
  sd_col = "SD",
  rep_col = "total_replicates",
  unit_col = "Concentration_unit",
  title = "",
  logtransform = T
)

# ============================================================
# Combine SIDE-BY-SIDE
# ============================================================

combined_plot = (
  p_studies | p_merged | plog_merged
) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")


combined_plot
ggsave('../Figures/BMD/BMD_preparation/FigS3/merging_pipeline.png', height = 5, width = 12)
```
